## Walkthrough

Adds `.coderabbit.yaml` configuring CodeRabbit: sets language to `en-US`, enables `knowledge_base.code_guidelines`, defines path-based filters (excluding generated/vendor files), provides detailed per-path review instructions for APIs, controllers, webhooks, scheduler, tests, Helm charts, and site docs, and enables auto-review with title/branch/label rules.

## Changes

**CodeRabbit configuration**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**CodeRabbit configuration and global settings** <br> `.coderabbit.yaml`|Adds `.coderabbit.yaml` with `language: en-US`, enables `knowledge_base.code_guidelines` from `AGENTS.md`, and defines review request workflow flags and path exclusion filters for `client-go/**`, Go generated files (`*_generated*.go`, `zz_generated.*.go`, `openapi_generated.go`), and `vendor/**`.|
|**Per-path review instructions** <br> `.coderabbit.yaml`|Adds `reviews.path_instructions` with targeted guidance for `apis/**/*.go` (CRD/API conventions), controllers and reconciliation behavior, webhooks (validation/mutation), constants naming/uniqueness, scheduler correctness/performance, integration and e2e tests, Helm charts/templates, `site/**/*.md` accuracy, and `**/*_test.go` test-writing guidance.|
|**Auto-review behavior** <br> `.coderabbit.yaml`|Enables `reviews.auto_review`, sets ignore-title keywords (`WIP`, `DO NOT MERGE`), disables draft handling, restricts `base_branches` to `main`, and excludes the `needs-ok-to-test` label from auto-review.|
